- **MD/M-EXPORT-001/1** (manufacturing-decision; 32-mbom.yaml M-EXPORT-001): The CFR graph (from the clock plan; P/Q = the output rate reduced; d = 1/R; seek = the double SeekTarget (or 0 when the first kept time is below 1.0 s), printed for -ss with 0.###### and taken at its exact binary value inside the window arithmetic; guard = d/4; a window bound is printed exactly when it has at most six decimals, otherwise the start is moved down and the end up by the guard; n0 = SourceFirstFrame): per run with FrameCount > 0, video `[0:v]trim=start=<n0·d − seek>:end=<(n0 + SourceFrameCount)·d − seek>,trim=end_frame=<SourceFrameCount>,` then, for an identity run (speed 1, F = R, S·R, E·R and T·F integers) `settb=Q/P,setpts=N[vk]`; otherwise `settb=Q/P,setpts=ceil((N*A+(B))/D),fps=P/Q:round=up,trim=start_pts=1,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,tpad=stop=<FrameCount + 8>:stop_mode=clone,trim=end_frame=<FrameCount>,settb=Q/P,setpts=N[vk]` where st = d·F/speed = A/D reduced, o = T·F − FirstFrameUnclamped + 1 + (n0·d − S)·F/speed, B = ceil(o·D) (write `N*A+(B)` when D = 1). Audio per run with BoundaryEnd > BoundaryStart, from the unseeked input: `atrim=start=<S>:end=<E>` when S and E are exact at six decimals and whole samples, else `atrim=start_sample=<SampleStart>:end_sample=<SampleEnd>`; then `asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,`, the tempo filters when speed ≠ 1, `volume=<v>,` when the volume is not 1, then `apad=whole_len=<len>,atrim=end_sample=<len>,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[ak]` with len = BoundaryEnd − BoundaryStart. Then `[v0]..concat=n=<runs>:v=1:a=0[cv];[a0]..concat=n=<runs>:v=0:a=1[ca];[cv]<scale or null>[vout];[ca]anull[aout]`. The tempo filters apply when the run's rational speed ≠ 1 exactly; `volume=` when |volume − 1| ≥ 0.001; asetrate's rate is printed with 0.######. Without audio (clip.HasAudio false) there is no audio chain, no [ca] and no [aout]; the maps are `-map "[vout]"` and, with audio, `-map "[aout]"`. The acceptance compares the output, not this text (20-spec.md §2.7).
